EMALAHLENI (Witbank, Mpumalanga) - TAX INVOICE/STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT, same billing vendor (eMunsoft) as KwaDukuza / Abaqulusi / Alfred Duma / Bela-Bela. Fingerprint is pinned on the masthead 'Emalahleni Local Municipality' AND VAT number 4000142457; both strings were verified to occur in exactly the 9 Emalahleni bills and nowhere else in the 219-PDF Telkom tree.

TWO TEMPLATE VARIANTS IN ONE FOLDER
- VARIANT A (8 of 9 bills, ~43 KB each): masthead 'VAT No.:4000142457', heading 'TAX INVOICE/STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT', labels 'Tax Invoice No.:' / 'Vat Registration No.:', meter table columns METER NO. / METER TYPE / OLD READING / NEW READING / READING DATE / READING TYPE / CONSUMPTION. One reading date only -> canonical End Date, no period start.
- VARIANT B (1 of 9: 'WIT_[number removed]_Emalahleni [number removed].pdf', 26 JUL 2026, 184 KB): NOT a scan and NOT multi-page - 1 page, 4,862 chars, text layer intact. The extra 140 KB is embedded artwork (bank logos / payat.io QR). It is the NEWER eMunsoft render: masthead 'VAT No: 4000142457', heading 'TAX INVOICE / STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT' (spaces around the slash), 'Tax Invoice No:' / 'VAT Registration No:' (no dots), an 'https://mymunicipality-mp312.emunsoft.co.za' portal line, no 'Suburb:' label at all, and the meter table becomes METER NO. / METER TYPE / OLD READING / NEW READING / <type letter> / CONSUMPTION / LEVIED AMOUNT / READING DATES where READING DATES is a RANGE '01/06/2026 - 01/07/2026' -> canonical Start Date AND End Date. This is the same A/B split that separates Bela-Bela (A) from Alfred Duma (B), except Emalahleni's variant B KEEPS the reading-type letter (Alfred Duma's drops it).
  Both variants are handled by ONE pattern per field: the CONSUMPTION column is always the first .3-decimal number AFTER the reading-type letter, so '(?:<date>[ \t]+)?([A-Z])[ \t]+(cons)' covers A and B together. Dates need two rules because their column positions genuinely differ: read_end uses a two-pattern fallback (variant A single date, then variant B range end) and read_start is a variant-B-only rule.

METER TABLE
- METER TYPE values seen: ELECTRICITY, KVA, WATER. The KVA rows are a real kVA register: OLD .000 -> NEW = the month's maximum demand, and CONSUMPTION = NEW READING (a demand level, not a difference). Summed KVA CONSUMPTION equals the ledger's 00E040 units on all 9 bills - that is identity 2 below, and it is why Demand kVA is filled here (unlike Abaqulusi, which prints no kVA anywhere).
- MULTI-METER: variant B (bill 1) carries a meter swap - ELECTRICITY [number removed] (type A, real movement) plus the retired ELECTRICITY [number removed] (type N, equal old/new, .000), and the same pair on KVA. Meter number is join_unique; readings and consumption are collect:'sum' over all ELECTRICITY rows (Alfred Duma convention). The retired meter contributes the same value to OLD and NEW, so END-START still equals Total kWh exactly. NOTE the Start/End Reading columns on that one bill are therefore a SUM of two registers (7,522,048.670 / 7,566,661.650), not a single meter's dial.
- READING TYPE letters seen: S (8 bills, on ELECTRICITY and KVA), A and N (variant B), I (water only). TRANSLATE has entries for A and E only, so reading_type is a join_unique of the raw letters: a lone 'A' translates to 'Actual', anything else is passed through EXACTLY as printed ('S', 'A/N'). 'S' is NOT guessed at - see the report; it appears on a continuous month-by-month reading chain with genuine varying consumption, but this vendor's letter set is undocumented and Modimolle-Mookgophong's bills prove 'N' can carry a real reading movement, so no letter beyond A/E is invented here.

ACCOUNT DETAILS LEDGER: DATE / CODE / DESCRIPTION / UNITS / TARIFF / VALUE. UNLIKE the rest of this family there is NO '@' and NO tariff rate printed - the TARIFF column is always blank. Descriptions are bare service words ('ELECTRICITY' three times over), so the CODE is the only discriminator. A '*' before VALUE is the VAT flag. Credits print a TRAILING minus ('143,315.86-').

LEDGER CODES SEEN (all 9 bills, complete)
  00E074 ELECTRICITY  units 250.000, value 31,125.00 on EVERY bill (R124.50/unit) -> other_r
  00E051 ELECTRICITY  units = metered kWh + 1.000 exactly            -> standard energy
  00E040 ELECTRICITY  units = the KVA register CONSUMPTION            -> demand (kVA)
  00T108 RATES        no '*' flag, no units                          -> rates (not VAT-able)
  00S015 SEWERAGE     units = the WATER meter consumption            -> sewerage
  00W007 WATER        units = water kL (metered, +1 on variant B)     -> water consumption
  00W013 WATER        units 1.000, value 537.76 flat                  -> water basic charge
  008888 PAYMENT      trailing minus                                  -> payments
  009008 VAT                                                          -> tax line

00E074 IS DELIBERATELY *NOT* MAPPED TO NMD: 250.000 units at a flat R124.50 every single month smells like a notified-capacity / NMD charge, but the bill prints no tariff name, no unit and no 250-kVA figure anywhere in the meter table, so asserting nmd_kva = 250 would be fabrication. It lands in Other Charges Rands, exactly as Abaqulusi's flat DEMAND/SERVICE BASIC CHARGE does. Flagged in the report for Edwin to confirm with the municipality.

THE +1 UNIT QUIRK: 00E051 units are the meter's CONSUMPTION plus exactly 1.000 on all 9 bills (18137->18138 ... 44612.980->44613.980). Total kWh is mapped to the METER consumption (the metered truth, and the figure that reconciles with END-START), Standard kWh to the BILLED 00E051 units. The two therefore differ by 1.000 by design, not by a regex error.

PRIOR-PERIOD LINES: there are NONE in these 9 bills - no correction, rebate, adjustment or reversal line of any kind, so no exclusion decision was needed. Because the '@' discriminator that Abaqulusi/Modimolle use does not exist on this layout, the guard is instead a catch-all field ema_other_elec_r that sums ANY 00E-coded ledger line that is not 051/040/074. It is 0/9 on this folder; if a future rebate or correction code appears it shows up in that field and in Other Charges rather than being silently dropped.

NOT PRINTED ANYWHERE (mapped '_none'): tariff name, TOU bands (peak/off-peak kWh and Rands), NMD, cash, guarantee, security held, and any per-service or ex-VAT subtotal. Start Date is printed on variant B only (1 of 9 = 11% fill, correct).

SITE NAME is thin: Street = 'RATES TAXESTELKOM PROP.' on all 9 bills, Suburb is an empty label (variant A) or absent (variant B), Consumer Name is always '. TELKOM SA TFMC PTY LTD'. site_name is concat(Street, Suburb) = 'RATES TAXESTELKOM PROP.' - that is genuinely all the statement identifies the site by; ERF Description ('00000 [number removed] 000000 0000') is kept separately as ema_erf.

RULE ZERO / RECONCILE IS CIRCULAR: the bill prints no per-service subtotal and no ex-VAT electricity total, so total_ex_vat_r is the sum of the same parts the Rand columns hold and the app's reconcile check proves nothing. The three GENUINE checks are (1) VAT: printed 009008 == 15% of ema_vatable_r (every '*' line, a separate document-scope rule); (2) kVA: summed KVA-register CONSUMPTION == 00E040 units; (3) roll-forward: OPENING BALANCE + payments + all '*' lines + RATES + printed VAT == printed CLOSING BALANCE.

Ageing row is 6 money columns (120+/90/60/30/CURRENT/CLOSING BALANCE). CURRENT is the net current balance, NOT the current levy, so recon 'current_ex' is left unmapped.

fields.label: Meter-table LEVIED AMOUNT (variant B only, summed)
kVA register CONSUMPTION (= max demand, summed)
Any OTHER 00E-coded line (guard: 0/9 on this folder)
